risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera's model name on the body, or a photo of the serial number and model label.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic Nikon DSLR, not D810

risks.risk: The lens may not be a 24-70mm NIKKOR, or may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens barrel showing the model name, or a photo of the lens mounted on a camera with a viewfinder or screen showing the lens in focus.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic lens, not 24-70mm NIKKOR

risks.risk: The camera may be non-functional, have a damaged sensor, or have internal issues.

risks.risk: The camera may have been tampered with or have a high shutter count, indicating heavy use.
risks.proof: A photo of the shutter count display on the camera's LCD screen, or a video showing the camera's menu settings.

A close-up photo of the lens barrel showing the model name.
A video or photo showing the camera powering on and the lens focusing.
